other_failure_modes.name: Test Data Leakage in Feature Engineering
other_failure_modes.description: The agent concatenates the training and test datasets to compute frequency, count, and unique-value encodings for categorical features. This practice leaks the test set's feature distribution into the training data, which is an invalid assumption since test distribution statistics would be unavailable for unseen data in a real-world production environment.

summary: The agent provides a highly sophisticated and robust solution, featuring zero-inflation stratified k-fold CV, rigorous out-of-fold target encoding, and optimized ensembling. However, it improperly leaks test set distribution statistics into the training data by calculating categorical frequency and count encodings on the combined train and test sets. Additionally, it relies solely on RMSE for evaluation, missing the opportunity to use metrics like MAE for better outlier robustness.
